notes: Sheet has two parts. MAIN = everything right of / above the heavy black border that runs from (100,3000) diagonally to (1950,3800) and then straight down to the bottom edge. INSET = the lower-left area inside that border: the east side of Vine north of No. 2000 Vine (Mulberry west end, Loth St, Peete Alley, Peete St), drawn out of position (roughly 900 px left and 1,630 px below where it belongs; same orientation and scale), so each pick carries part main/inset and the inset needs its own georeference. Inset Peete St runs off the border with a '161' reference = the main-panel Peete. North on this sheet is about 32 deg left of up. Names printed bare (ALEXANDER (Not Open), DORSEY, GOETHE, MULBERRY, PEETE, FRINTZ, RICE, VINE); E. CLIFTON AV., E. McMICKEN, HURST ALLEY, FINDLAY ST., LOTH ST. as printed. Alexander is printed '(Not Open)' and ends at Goethe. Rice ends at Mulberry; a 10 ft stairway continues south from Mulberry to Peete at x~1035. Frintz between Mulberry and Peete is a 50 ft stairway (x~3640, y 2140-2500), so Frintz/Mulberry is not picked as a street crossing. An unnamed 16 ft alley runs N-S at x~1498 from the top edge (continues north) down to Mulberry, midway between Rice and Alexander. 'VERY ST. BLUFF' at top left is a 'very steep bluff' note, not a street. Vine's west face is not drawn on the main panel ('See Volume Three'), so the Vine points are set 112 px (33 ft) SW of the east block face. Mulberry, Goethe and Dorsey run off the right edge onto 162; Mulberry's main-panel west end at x~590 is just where the drawing stops on the hillside. In the inset, Loth St runs north from Mulberry to the inset border (continues on 170); a 10 ft passage runs from Vine (x~1050, y~4230) NNE to the west end of Peete Alley. Findlay St (no width printed) comes up from the bottom edge (x~2160) to the Vine/McMicken crossing.
